Yaa Seen
Quran-e-Hakeem ki qasam
Aap mursaleen mein se hain
Bilkul seedhe raaste par hain
Yeh Quran Khuda-e-Azeez o Meharbaan ka naazil kiya hua hai
Taake aap us qaum ko daraayein jis ke baap daada ko kisi paighambar ke zariye nahin daraaya gaya, to sab ghaafil hi reh gaye
Yaqeenan un ki aksariyat par hamaara azaab saabit ho gaya, to woh imaan laane waale nahin hain
Hum ne un ki gardan mein tauq daal diye hain jo un ki thuddiyon tak pahunche hue hain, aur woh sar uthaaye hue hain
Aur hum ne ek deewaar un ke saamne aur ek deewaar un ke peechhe bana di hai, aur phir inhein azaab se dhaank diya hai ke woh kuch dekhne ke qaabil nahin reh gaye hain
Aur un ke liye sab baraabar hai, aap inhein daraayein ya na daraayein, yeh imaan laane waale nahin hain
Aap sirf un logon ko dara sakte hain jo naseehat ka ittibaa' karein aur baghair dekhe az-ghaib Khuda se darte rahein. Unhi logon ko aap maghfirat aur ba-izzat ajr ki bashaarat de dein
Beshak hum hi murdon ko zinda karte hain, aur un ke guzashta aamaal aur un ke aasaar ko likhte jaate hain, aur hum ne har shai ko ek raushan Imaam mein jama kar diya hai
Aur Paighambar! Aap un se ba-taur-e-misaal us qarya waalon ka tazkira karein jin ke paas hamaare rasool aaye
Is tarah ke hum ne do rasoolon ko bheja to un logon ne jhutla diya, to hum ne un ki madad ko teesra rasool bhi bheja, aur sab ne mil kar e'laan kiya ke hum sab tumhaari taraf bheje gaye hain
Un logon ne kaha tum sab hamaare hi jaise bashar ho, aur Rehmaan ne kisi shai ko naazil nahin kiya hai, tum sirf jhooth bolte ho
Unhon ne jawaab diya ke hamaara Parwardigar jaanta hai ke hum tumhaari taraf bheje gaye hain
Aur hamaari zimmedaari sirf waazeh taur par paighaam pahuncha dena hai
Un logon ne kaha ke humein tum manhoos maaloom hote ho. Agar apni baaton se baaz na aaoge to hum sangsaar kar denge aur hamaari taraf se tumhein sakht saza di jaaegi
Un logon ne jawaab diya ke tumhaari nahoosat tumhaare saath hai. Kya yeh yaad-dahaani koi nahoosat hai? Haqeeqat yeh hai ke tum zyaadati karne waale log ho
Aur shehar ke ek sire se ek shakhs daudta hua aaya aur us ne kaha ke qaum waalo! Mursaleen ka ittibaa' karo
Un ka ittibaa' karo jo tum se kisi tarah ki ujrat ka sawaal nahin karte hain aur hidaayat-yaafta hain
Aur mujhe kya ho gaya hai ke main us ki ibaadat na karoon jis ne mujhe paida kiya hai, aur tum sab usi ki baargaah mein palataaye jaaoge
Kya main us ke ilaawa doosre khuda ikhtiyaar kar loon, jab ke woh mujhe nuqsaan pahunchaana chaahe to kisi ki sifaarish kaam aane waali nahin hai aur na koi bacha sakta hai
Main to us waqt khuli hui gumraahi mein ho jaaoonga
Main tumhaare Parwardigar par imaan laaya hoon, lihaaza tum meri baat suno
Nateeje mein us bande se kaha gaya ke Jannat mein daakhil ho ja, to us ne kaha ke aye kaash meri qaum ko bhi maaloom hota
Ke mere Parwardigar ne kis tarah bakhsh diya hai aur mujhe ba-izzat logon mein qaraar diya hai
Aur hum ne us ki qaum par us ke baad na aasmaan se koi lashkar bheja hai aur na hum lashkar bhejne waale the
Woh to sirf ek chinghaad thi jis ke baad sab ka sho'la-e-hayaat sard pad gaya
Kis qadar hasratnaak hai un bandon ka haal ke jab un ke paas koi rasool aata hai to us ka mazaaq udaane lagte hain
Kya un logon ne nahin dekha ke hum ne un se pehle kitni qaumon ko halaak kar diya hai jo ab un ki taraf palat kar aane waali nahin hain
Aur phir sab ek din ikattha hamaare paas haazir kiye jaayenge
Aur un ke liye hamaari ek nishaani yeh murda zameen bhi hai jise hum ne zinda kiya hai aur us mein daane nikaale hain jin mein se yeh log kha rahe hain
Aur isi zameen mein khurme aur angoor ke baaghaat paida kiye hain aur chashme jaari kiye hain
Taake yeh us ke phal khaayein, haalaanke yeh sab un ke haathon ka amal nahin hai, phir aakhir yeh hamaara shukriya kyon nahin ada karte hain
Paak o be-niyaaz hai woh Khuda jis ne tamaam jodon ko paida kiya hai, un cheezon mein se jinhein zameen ugaati hai aur un ke nufoos mein se, aur un cheezon mein se jin ka inhein ilm bhi nahin hai
Aur un ke liye ek nishaani raat hai jis mein se hum kheench kar din ko nikaal lete hain to yeh sab andhere mein chale jaate hain
Aur aaftaab apne ek markaz par daud raha hai, ke yeh Khuda-e-Azeez o Aleem ki mu'ayyan ki hui harkat hai
Aur chaand ke liye bhi hum ne manzilein mu'ayyan kar di hain yahaan tak ke woh aakhir mein palat kar khajoor ki sookhi tehni jaisa ho jaata hai
Na aaftaab ke bas mein hai ke chaand ko pakad le aur na raat ke liye mumkin hai ke woh din se aage badh jaaye, aur yeh sab ke sab apne apne falak aur madaar mein tairte rehte hain
Aur un ke liye hamaari ek nishaani yeh bhi hai ke hum ne un ke buzurgon ko ek bhari hui kashti mein uthaaya hai
Aur us kashti jaisi aur bahut si cheezein paida ki hain jin par yeh sawaar hote hain
Aur agar hum chaahein to sab ko gharq kar dein, phir na koi un ka faryaad-ras paida hoga aur na yeh bachaaye ja sakenge
Magar yeh ke khud hamaari rehmat shaamil-e-haal ho jaaye aur hum ek muddat tak aaraam karne dein
Aur jab un se kaha jaata hai ke us azaab se daro jo saamne ya peechhe se aa sakta hai, shaayad ke tum par rahm kiya jaaye
To un ke paas Khuda ki nishaaniyon mein se koi nishaani nahin aati hai magar yeh ke yeh kinaara-kashi ikhtiyaar kar lete hain

Aur jab kaha jaata hai ke jo rizq Khuda ne diya hai us mein se us ki raah mein kharch karo to yeh kuffaar saahibaan-e-imaan se tanziya taur par kehte hain ke hum unhein kyon khilaayein jinhein Khuda chaahta to khud hi khila deta, tum log to khuli hui gumraahi mein mubtala ho
Aur phir kehte hain ke aakhir yeh waada-e-qiyaamat kab poora hoga agar tum log apne waade mein sachche ho
Dar-haqeeqat yeh sirf ek chinghaad ka intezaar kar rahe hain jo inhein apni giraft mein le legi, aur yeh jhagda hi karte reh jaayenge
Phir na koi wasiyyat kar paayenge aur na apne ahl ki taraf palat kar hi ja sakenge
Aur phir jab Soor phoonka jaaega to sab ke sab apni qabron se nikal kar apne Parwardigar ki taraf chal khade honge
Kahenge ke aakhir yeh humein hamaari khwaabgaah se kis ne utha diya hai? Beshak yahi woh cheez hai jis ka Khuda ne waada kiya tha aur us ke rasoolon ne sach kaha tha
Qiyaamat to sirf ek chinghaad hai, us ke baad sab hamaari baargaah mein haazir kar diye jaayenge
Phir aaj ke din kisi nafs par kisi tarah ka zulm nahin kiya jaaega, aur tum ko sirf waisa hi badla diya jaaega jaise aamaal tum kar rahe the
Beshak ahl-e-Jannat aaj ke din tarah tarah ke mashaaghil mein maze kar rahe honge
Woh aur un ki biwiyaan sab Jannat ki chhaaon mein takht par takiye lagaaye aaraam kar rahe honge
Un ke liye taaza taaza meve honge aur us ke ilaawa jo kuch bhi woh chaahenge
Un ke haq mein un ke meharbaan Parwardigar ka qaul sirf salaamati hoga
Aur aye mujrimo! Tum zara un se alag to ho jaao
Aulaad-e-Aadam! Kya hum ne tum se is baat ka ahd nahin liya tha ke khabardaar Shaitaan ki ibaadat na karna ke woh tumhaara khula hua dushman hai
Aur meri ibaadat karna ke yahi Siraat-e-Mustaqeem aur seedha raasta hai
Is Shaitaan ne tum mein se bahut si naslon ko gumraah kar diya hai, to kya tum bhi aql istemaal nahin karoge
Yahi woh Jahannam hai jis ka tum se duniya mein waada kiya ja raha tha
Aaj isi mein chale jaao ke tum hamesha kufr ikhtiyaar kiya karte the
Aaj hum un ke munh par mohr laga denge, aur un ke haath bolenge aur un ke paaon gawaahi denge ke yeh kaise aamaal anjaam diya karte the
Aur hum agar chaahein to un ki aankhon ko mita dein, phir yeh raaste ki taraf qadam badhaate rahein lekin kahaan dekh sakte hain
Aur hum chaahein to khud unhi ko bilkul maskh kar dein jis ke baad na aage qadam badha sakein aur na peechhe hi palat kar waapas aa sakein
Aur hum jise taweel umr dete hain use khilqat mein bachpane ki taraf waapas kar dete hain, kya yeh log samajhte nahin hain
Aur hum ne apne paighambar ko she'r ki ta'leem nahin di hai aur na shaa'iri us ke shaayaan-e-shaan hai. Yeh to ek naseehat aur khula hua raushan Quran hai
Taake us ke zariye zinda afraad ko azaab-e-Ilaahi se daraayein, aur kuffaar par hujjat tamaam ho jaaye
Kya un logon ne nahin dekha ke hum ne un ke faaide ke liye apne dast-e-qudrat se chaupaaye paida kar diye hain, to ab yeh un ke maalik kahe jaate hain
Aur phir hum ne un jaanwaron ko raam kar diya hai, to ba'z se sawaari ka kaam lete hain aur ba'z ko khaate hain
Aur un ke liye un jaanwaron mein bahut se fawaaid hain aur peene ki cheezein bhi hain, to yeh shukr-e-Khuda kyon nahin karte hain
Aur un logon ne Khuda ko chhod kar doosre khuda bana liye hain ke shaayad un ki madad ki jaaegi
Haalaanke yeh un ki madad ki taaqat nahin rakhte hain, aur yeh un ke aise lashkar hain jinhein khud bhi Khuda ki baargaah mein haazir kiya jaaega
Lihaaza Paighambar! Aap un ki baaton se ranjeeda na hon, hum woh bhi jaante hain jo yeh chhupa rahe hain aur woh bhi jaante hain jis ka yeh izhaar kar rahe hain
To kya insaan ne yeh nahin dekha ke hum ne use nutfe se paida kiya hai aur woh yakbaargi hamaara khula hua dushman ho gaya hai
Aur hamaare liye misl bayaan karta hai aur apni khilqat ko bhool gaya hai. Kehta hai ke in boseeda haddiyon ko kaun zinda kar sakta hai
Aap keh dijiye ke jis ne pehli martaba paida kiya hai wahi zinda bhi karega, aur woh har makhlooq ka behtar jaanne waala hai
Us ne tumhaare liye hare darakht se aag paida kar di hai to tum us se saari aag raushan karte rahe ho
To kya jis ne zameen o aasmaan ko paida kiya hai woh is baat par qaadir nahin hai ke un ka misl dobaara paida kar de? Yaqeenan hai, aur woh behtareen paida karne waala aur jaanne waala hai
Us ka amr sirf yeh hai ke kisi shai ke baare mein yeh kehne ka iraada kar le ke ho ja, aur woh shai ho jaati hai
Pas paak o be-niyaaz hai woh Khuda jis ke haathon mein har shai ka iqtidaar hai, aur tum sab usi ki baargaah mein palta kar le jaaye jaaoge
